section.name: Together
pair.name: Reading for friends
pair.description: You and a friend or someone close each draw three cards for the same positions: what I bring, what I hope for, what's hard to say. The Tarot reads them together and shows where your views meet and where they differ. The other person draws their cards from a link on their own phone and decides whether to show them.

couple.name: For lovers
couple.description: For two people who are together: enter your names and a shared question, then draw five cards — his feelings, her feelings, what connects you, what gets in the way and advice for the couple. The Tarot reads them as one story and suggests what's worth talking about. All on one phone — easy to do together.
